Downstream breaking changes 1

high

Generated SDK enum shape changes

CloudHsmClusterSkuName changes from an enum to a named string-literal union. Although its two wire values are unchanged and the union has no open string arm, the declaration-kind change can alter the generated SDK public type shape and enum-member identities, breaking source code that references the prior enum surface without requiring any REST operation change.

Evidence: Replacing an enum with a string-backed union can change generated enum shape and member identities while preserving wire values.; Changed TypeSpec source: specification/hardwaresecuritymodules/resource-manager/Microsoft.HardwareSecurityModules/HardwareSecurityModules/models.tsp.

Semantic intents 1

1✏️⚠️ Make Cloud HSM cluster SKU names forward-compatible with an open string union 5 operations

CloudHsmClusterSkuName changes from a closed enum to an open string union. The known wire values Standard_B1 and Standard B10 remain unchanged, while the string variant allows future service values without changing the REST shape.

API surface: 5 existing operations affected

ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact
✏️ Modified `sku.name` accepted values The closed enum accepts only Standard_B1 and Standard B10. The open string union preserves both known values and accepts future string values.
Generated SDK enum shape changes

TypeSpec change: Replace the suppressed enum with a union that includes string and preserves both named values.
